fixedMinorAttributes.type: Damage To Target Out of Cover

setBonuses.title: Dead Man's Hand
setBonuses.description: Flipping cards while landing shots with a marksman rifle increases the next shot's damage by 30%.

setBonuses.title: Stoic
setBonuses.description: Grants +3% damage resistance for every enemy targeting you, multiplied by the number of agents in your group.

setBonuses.title: On Point
setBonuses.description: Landing a shot with a rifle or marksman rifle grants a stack. Reloading gives +2% weapon handling and weapon damage per stack for 10 seconds.

setBonuses.title: Indirect Transmission
setBonuses.description: Status effects now spread to nearby enemies within 10 meters when you kill an affected target.

setBonuses.title: Makeshift Repairs
setBonuses.description: When you or your shield take damage, 25% of the damage is repaired over 10 seconds.

setBonuses.title: Ground Control
setBonuses.description: Increases your and your allies' weapon and skill damage by 15% while at full armor.

setBonuses.title: Feedback Loop
setBonuses.description: Whenever you use or cancel a skill, your other skill's cooldown is reduced by 30 seconds.

setBonuses.title: Heartstopper
setBonuses.description: Headshots apply a pulse for 5 seconds. Weapon hits on pulsed enemies add a stack of 1% bonus armor and 1% weapon damage, stacking up to 50 times.

setBonuses.title: Headache
setBonuses.description: The first headshot with a marksman rifle increases the next headshot's damage by 20%.

setBonuses.title: Apex Predator
setBonuses.description: Enemies within 15 meters receive a debuff, amplifying your weapon damage by 20%. Killing a debuffed enemy disorients others within 5 meters.

setBonuses.title: Hostile Negotiations
setBonuses.description: Critical hits mark enemies for 20 seconds. Critically hitting a marked enemy causes other marked enemies to take 60% of the damage dealt.

setBonuses.title: Rules of Engagement
setBonuses.description: Shooting a status-affected enemy marks them. Killing a marked enemy grants Hollow-Point Ammo.

setBonuses.title: Ortiz Incinerator Turret Prototype
setBonuses.description: The Incinerator Turret rotates 360 degrees. You are immune to your own Incinerator Turret's fire. The turret explodes upon being disabled.

setBonuses.title: Tend and Befriend
setBonuses.description: Interacting with deployed skills grants them a 25% skill damage boost for 10 seconds.

setBonuses.title: Striker's Gamble
setBonuses.description: Weapon hits increase total weapon damage by 0.65%, stacking up to 100 times.

setBonuses.title: Hackstep Protocol
setBonuses.description: Replaces armor kits with a 20-second cooldown skill that repairs 20% armor.

setBonuses.title: Charging
setBonuses.description: For each second spent out of cover during combat, agents will get 5% reduced incoming skill damage, max 50%.

setBonuses.title: Aggressive Recon
setBonuses.description: Getting a kill with a Signature Weapon boosts its damage by 15% for 10 seconds.

setBonuses.title: Red, White, and Blue
setBonuses.description: Shooting enemies applies stacking debuffs: Red, White, and Blue.

setBonuses.title: From the Shadows & Into the Light
setBonuses.description: Gain stacks that increase critical hit damage and armor regeneration based on cover status.
